obligations.subject: e27
obligations.response: shall always be based on and related to the test area with undeployed DPPS
obligations.ears: The selection of impact points and the allocation of the HIC1700 and HIC1000 zones for the headform test procedure at nominal velocity (9.7m/s) shall always be based on and related to the test area with undeployed DPPS.

obligations.subject: e39
obligations.response: the following conditions shall be fulfilled
obligations.ears: When the vehicle manufacturer opts for the static test procedure, the following conditions shall be fulfilled.

obligations.subject: e39
obligations.response: the headform tests on the headform test area shall be performed statically
obligations.ears: When the conditions are fulfilled, the headform tests on the headform test area shall be performed statically.

obligations.subject: e20
obligations.response: the headform tests on the headform test area shall be performed dynamically
obligations.ears: If any of the following conditions are not met, the headform tests on the headform test area shall be performed dynamically.

obligations.subject: e39
obligations.response: all tests may be performed statically
obligations.ears: Where the vehicle manufacturer has demonstrated by numerical simulations on the deployed DPPS that HIT_d ≥ TRT for the smallest selected pedestrian stature, as defined in Annex 2, all tests may be performed statically.

obligations.subject: e32
obligations.response: shall represent the deployed position (see Figure 1-1, B section) within the specified tolerances, while the resisting force is considered
obligations.ears: During the static test, the vehicle outer surface shall represent the deployed position (see Figure 1-1, B section) within the specified tolerances, while the resisting force is considered.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the launching time of the headform impactor shall ensure that the system remains stable (tolerance ±10 per cent of corresponding resisting force), as identified by the manufacturer
obligations.ears: When there is a constraint on time for the stability of the system and HIT_d ≥TRT, the launching time of the headform impactor shall ensure that the system remains stable (tolerance ±10 per cent of corresponding resisting force), as identified by the manufacturer (prerequisite in paragraph 1.2. of Annex 1).

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: it shall be ensured that the resisting force of the DPPS is equivalent to the actual situation at HIT
obligations.ears: During the static tests, it shall be ensured that the resisting force of the DPPS is equivalent to the actual situation at HIT.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: Appropriate means (e.g. actuator surrogates) may be used to ensure that the corresponding resisting force of the DPPS is reached
obligations.ears: During the static tests, appropriate means (e.g. actuator surrogates) may be used to ensure that the corresponding resisting force of the DPPS is reached.

obligations.subject: e39
obligations.response: The test procedures specified in paragraphs 7.2. to 7.4. of this Regulation shall apply
obligations.ears: For the static test option, the test procedures specified in paragraphs 7.2. to 7.4. of this Regulation shall apply.

obligations.subject: e39
obligations.response: one headform test at the discretion of the test laboratory may be conducted on the undeployed DPPS to confirm that impact velocity and impact location are within tolerances
obligations.ears: Prior to conducting the static tests at 9.7 m/s, one headform test at the discretion of the test laboratory may be conducted on the undeployed DPPS to confirm that impact velocity and impact location are within tolerances.

obligations.subject: e39
obligations.response: Alternative methods to demonstrate the test accuracy may also be accepted
obligations.ears: Alternative methods to demonstrate the test accuracy at impact location may also be accepted.

obligations.subject: e20
obligations.response: one headform test at the discretion of the test laboratory shall be conducted on the undeployed DPPS to confirm that impact velocity and impact location are within tolerances
obligations.ears: Prior to conducting the dynamic tests at 9.7m/s, one headform test at the discretion of the test laboratory shall be conducted on the undeployed DPPS to confirm that impact velocity and impact location are within tolerances.

obligations.subject: e20
obligations.response: HIT_s and ST are required inputs, which shall be established by the following
obligations.ears: To enable dynamic testing to be conducted, HIT_s and ST shall be established by the following.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall ensure that the head impact occurs at the correct time relative to the deployment of the DPPS, taking into account the HIT_s for the corresponding WAD of the head impact point from Figure 1-3 and ST

obligations.subject: e13
obligations.response: Combined static and dynamic tests may apply, at manufacturer’s choice
obligations.ears: Combined static and dynamic tests may apply, at manufacturer’s choice.

obligations.subject: e13
obligations.response: all test points forward of the corresponding WAD (HIT_d < TRT) shall be tested dynamically
obligations.ears: If the headform test area consists of sections where HIT_d <TRT and sections where HIT_d ≥TRT, all test points forward of the corresponding WAD (HIT_d < TRT) shall be tested dynamically.

obligations.subject: e13
obligations.response: The remaining section of the headform test area may be tested statically
obligations.ears: When combined testing applies, the remaining section of the headform test area may be tested statically (see Figure 1-5 below, obtained from Annex 2, Figure 2-2).
